title: I’ve never made a game or learned to code. Here’s my first attempt: a haunted potion café.
author: lollyadorable4
selftext:
Hey everyone! This is **Potion Café**, my first attempt at making a game.

The idea started with Café Mania, a café management game I played a lot growing up in Brazil. I wanted to capture that feeling of juggling orders and trying to keep everyone happy, but with Halloween coming up, the customers became witches, ghosts and goblins.

You mix ingredients, brew potions and serve customers before their patience runs out. The drinks have side effects: customers can float, change colors or turn into frogs.

My process has mostly been describing what I want, testing it, then asking for specific changes to the art, interface and mechanics. There’s been plenty of troubleshooting along the way, especially getting clicks to serve the right customer and making transformations actually look like transformations instead of just turning someone green. But the sick part for me was: it only took me a day, less, few hours, to make it. For some of you this might feel like "but its so simple" but truly, not for me!!

It’s still a work in progress. I’m working on the pacing, character designs and voices, but this is where it’s at so far.

Curious what you think: what would make this more fun to play?
